title: Mera waris hai ali
body:
Mera waris hai ali
man kunto mola fahaza ali yun mola ..(3)
mera waris hai ali..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
khum k maidaan me..(2)
ailaan ye karte the nabi
<<MINI>>
mera waris hai ali..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. adam o nuh o payamber hon ya hazrat musa, younis o khizr hon illiyas k hazrat esa, ghir k mushkil me yehi..(2)
kehta tha hr ek nabi
<<MINI>>
mera waris hai ali..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Qabr me mujhse nakeerain ne jb ye pocha, kon waris hai tera kon hai mola tera, mujhse pehle ye meri..(2)
qabr ki mati boli
<<MINI>>
mera waris hai ali..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Maut kya maut se dar jane ka qissa kya hai, shaam walon ne ali walon ko samjha kya hai, ghir ke taighon me bhi..(2)
kehta tha hajar ibn e adi
<<MINI>>
mera waris hai ali..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ghair e farrar ka karrar ka haq hai mujhpar, meri janib na kare koi sahabi bhi nazar, bola khaiber me alam..(2)
hath lagaye na koi
<<MINI>>
mera waris hai ali..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Khana e haq me nhi jayen ge dar se mola, un pe khul jaye ga aabayi wo rasta unka, junhi kaabe ke qareeb..(2) aake kahenge mehdi
<<MINI>>
mera waris hai ali..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Maut ke maathe pe ayega paseena ran me, hurmla aj se tu rota phirega ban me, sab se kehti rahi..(2)
maqtal me ye asghar ki hasi
<<MINI>>
mera waris hai ali..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Maine aada ke saron pr hi apna safar, meri taapon se hi marjaye ga sara lashkar, ye rajas parhte hue..(2)
ran me mujalli nikli
<<MINI>>
mera waris hai ali..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Mujhko mola mere alfaz se pehchanenge, meer ko lehja o awaaz se pehchane ge, roz e mehshar jo sada..(2)
gunjegi akbar apni
<<MINI>>
mera waris hai ali..(4)
man kunto mola fahaza ali yun mola ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
